verdict_reason: Repaired and verified. The task accepted the shared cache on population and document count WITHOUT checking that it holds hidden states, so a cache populated for an attention-only consumer returned None and the task emitted an error instead of self-collecting -- merely co-running another task deleted all 9 headlines. Verified directly: with a genuine attention-only ModelOutputCache (populated, correct document count, get_hidden_states None) the repaired task self-collects and emits 15 numeric keys instead of an error. 9 executed parity assertions against the official Vendi Score library pass.
